acceptances.given: The current Consumer Manifest and repository caller set are available for reconciliation.

oracle.expected: A bidirectional reconciliation covers the complete current manifest and VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing callers.
forbidden: Omission of VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing callers.
oracle.observable: The reconciled manifest and call-surface records.

acceptances.then: The complete Consumer Manifest is mutually reconciled with repository callers.

acceptances.given: A fresh-checkout semantic reconstruction is about to use pinned inputs.

oracle.expected: The Current Snapshot manifest immutably identifies every result-determining input before replay.
forbidden: Mutable, unbound, or historical-only inputs treated as current pinned inputs.

acceptances.then: All result-determining inputs are bound into the Current Snapshot.
acceptances.when: A semantic result is reconstructed from a fresh checkout.

acceptances.given: A checkout and its pinned Current Snapshot exist.

oracle.expected: The original target, validator, dependency, command, Probe, Consumer, snapshot, and evidence identities are reconstructed before a fresh replay process runs with those identities.
forbidden: A replay claim without fresh process execution.
oracle.observable: Identity-verification records, unchanged historical evidence, and fresh replay evidence.

acceptances.then: Fresh replay evidence is attributable to the exact reconstructed snapshot identities.
acceptances.when: Reproduction begins from a fresh checkout.

acceptances.given: A pinned Exact Cover graph and fresh replay evidence are available.

oracle.expected: The reconstructed graph equals the pinned graph and has no unexplained orphan obligations, assertions, selectors, commands, witnesses, or runtime-evidence nodes.
forbidden: Different Exact Cover reported as reproduced.

acceptances.then: Exact Cover equality and completeness are established.
acceptances.when: Fresh replay completes Exact Cover verification.

acceptances.given: A pinned terminal result exists and fresh replay has completed.

oracle.expected: Machine-verifiable fresh replay evidence records the same terminal semantic verdict as the pinned source result.
forbidden: A different verdict reported as reproduced.
oracle.observable: Pinned and fresh terminal verdict values.

acceptances.when: Fresh replay reaches its terminal result.

acceptances.given: Pinned diagnostic categories and fresh replay diagnostic output are available.

oracle.expected: Machine-verifiable evidence shows equality between pinned and fresh diagnostic categories.
forbidden: Different diagnostic categories reported as reproduced.
Diagnostics inferred from labels or prose.
oracle.observable: Pinned and fresh replay diagnostic-category records.

acceptances.given: A pinned semantic result and fresh replay receipts are available.

oracle.expected: Replay receipts prove equality of target, validator, dependency, command, Probe, Consumer, snapshot, and evidence bindings.
forbidden: Copied, stale, mismatched, or unattributed evidence accepted as reproduction.
Missing identity or evidence bindings accepted with a semantic result.
oracle.observable: Pinned and fresh identity/evidence binding receipts.

acceptances.then: Required identity and evidence relationships are reproduced.
acceptances.when: Fresh replay evidence is evaluated for semantic reproduction.

acceptances.given: A prior result is associated with a Current Snapshot.

oracle.expected: A changed result-determining snapshot member deterministically yields stale or fail-closed status before reproduction is accepted.
forbidden: Silent normalization of changed bound inputs.
A stale result reported as reproduced or successful.

acceptances.when: A snapshot-bound input differs during reconstruction or fresh replay.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove or omit a required VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing caller from the reconciled Consumer Manifest.
Omit one result-determining input from the Current Snapshot manifest.
Substitute a bound identity before fresh replay.
Alter one reconstructed Exact Cover relation or introduce an orphan node.
Cause fresh replay to emit a terminal verdict different from the pinned result.
Cause fresh replay diagnostics to differ from the pinned categories.
Replace one required identity or evidence binding in the fresh replay receipt.
Mutate a bound Current Snapshot member and attempt semantic reproduction.

slice_hints.behavior_change: Reconcile the complete current Consumer Manifest bidirectionally with real VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing call surfaces.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing route and receipt compatibility.

slice_hints.state_transition: Unreconciled manifest to bidirectionally reconciled frozen manifest.
slice_hints.terminal_predicate: Consumer closure validation proves both manifest-to-caller and caller-to-manifest coverage.

slice_hints.behavior_change: Create a complete immutable Current Snapshot binding before semantic replay.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Snapshot additions must preserve existing receipt compatibility.

slice_hints.state_transition: Unbound result inputs to a complete immutable Current Snapshot.
slice_hints.terminal_predicate: Every result-determining input has a canonical immutable identity in the snapshot.

slice_hints.behavior_change: Verify original binding identities without rewriting historical evidence, then run fresh replay using those same identities.
slice_hints.state_transition: Pinned identities not reconstructed to verified identities followed by fresh attributable execution.
slice_hints.terminal_predicate: Fresh-process replay evidence binds the exact reconstructed snapshot identities.

slice_hints.behavior_change: Validate equality and zero-orphan completeness of the fresh-replay Exact Cover graph.
slice_hints.state_transition: Unverified reconstructed coverage graph to equal, bidirectional, orphan-free graph.
slice_hints.terminal_predicate: Exact Cover comparison rejects any mismatch or orphan node.

slice_hints.behavior_change: Compare fresh replay terminal verdict with the pinned semantic result.
slice_hints.state_transition: Uncompared fresh terminal result to machine-verified verdict equality.
slice_hints.terminal_predicate: A reproduction claim is possible only when fresh and pinned terminal verdicts are equal.

slice_hints.behavior_change: Compare fresh replay diagnostic categories with the pinned semantic result.
slice_hints.state_transition: Uncompared fresh diagnostics to machine-verified diagnostic-category equality.
slice_hints.terminal_predicate: A reproduction claim is possible only when fresh and pinned diagnostics are equal.

slice_hints.behavior_change: Compare all required pinned and fresh identity/evidence bindings for semantic attribution.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve receipt compatibility while requiring complete bindings.

slice_hints.state_transition: Unverified replay attribution to equality of all required identity and evidence bindings.
slice_hints.terminal_predicate: Replay receipts prove equality of every required binding.

slice_hints.behavior_change: Invalidate reproduction when any bound result-determining input drifts without an approved versioned policy.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: A stale result must not be silently reinterpreted as success.

slice_hints.state_transition: Current snapshot-bound result to stale or fail-closed result after bound-input drift.
slice_hints.terminal_predicate: Any unexplained changed snapshot member prevents semantic reproduction.
